'''Danna Fajji''' was the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Hologram Fun World]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a short, rotund man with rosy cheeks and a scruffy [[Color/Legends|red]] goatee. Fajji demonstrated the [[Nightmare Machine]] for [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], insisting that it was perfectly safe. Further, he tried to con Calrissian into investing in the space-based theme park by filling the nearly vacant park with [[holograph]]ic visitors.
